items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
items.snippet: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

items.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
items.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

items.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
items.snippet: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
items.snippet: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

items.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
items.snippet: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.
